column1: # Diyanet's European method (since 1 Jan 2023): namazvakitleri.diyanet.gov.tr city tables, restricted:
# archive only. The first column is İmsak, both the Fajr start and the end of eating (F+E).
# Each city is its own point table (ruling R44), checked at its unit's point, and is held in two
# captures: the research's of 25/26 Sep 2026 (that month to 25/26 Oct, and all of 2027) and the
# monitor's of 28 Sep 2026 (29 Sep – 29 Oct 2026, and all of 2027; identical on every day both hold).
# North of 44.5° each city's Fajr, Isha and end of eating follow depression curves derived from every
# held row of its own table (DiyanetEuropeCurves, tools/timetables' generateDiyanetEuropeCurves), so
# those three columns are fitted on both captures, not held out; the other columns' margins are fitted
# on six cities spread from south to north (Sarajevo, Zürich, München, Paris, Berlin, Stockholm) and
# the other six held out. The monitor's captures are split=test throughout: they add the four days
# after the clock change of 25 Oct 2026, which no research capture holds, and the monitor round found
# the first curves a minute early there (brief D); the curves' derivation was rebuilt on them.
# Diyanet's tables for places beyond every held city (Copenhagen and nine Nordic cities) are not rows
# here: there the entry claims no "at most" figure; proof/7b-turkiye-balkans-russia.md gives their
